XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: injection

  • Device: injection control unit

  • Fault: The engine will not start and the engine fault, ESC, tyre pressure and braking system warning lights come on. Several warning messages appear on the instrument panel: “Hill Holder unavailable”, “Tyre pressure unavailable”, “Fuel cut-off unavailable” and “ESC unavailable”.

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following:
    • B1053 (Injection control unit: safety inertia switch control signal – Perform self-diagnostics)
    • B1901 (Cabin air distribution motor feedback signal – Wiring)
    • P0069 (Absolute pressure sensor, atmospheric pressure sensor – Incorrect reading)
    • P0230 (Fuel pump supply voltage – Fault)
    • P0606 (Engine injection control unit – performance module – Internal error)
    • P2227 (Atmospheric pressure sensor – Performance, incorrect functionality)
    • U0426 (Electronic key – error)
    • U0431 (Central Electronic Control Unit 1 (Body computer) – Invalid data received)
    • U1071 (Invalid or missing SCP data for engine sensors)
    • U1700 (CAN data bus – Body computer Communication error / no communication)
    • U1701 (NCM engine control, CAN transmission)
  • Cause: Faulty injection control unit

• Action: Check the condition and correct functioning of the injection control unit; replace if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the defective component did not show any visual abnormalities
